registry.name: Core-Lite Bundle Registry

observed_external_inventory.note: The ZIPs folder count is a local inventory signal. Not every item is a failure. The registry separates intentional bundle-only development from avoidable corrective or obsolete bundle churn.

registry.purpose: Track StegVerse ZIP bundle inventory, canonical current bundles, supersession, obsolete bundle churn, and estimated handling friction.
registry.rule: Bundle-only delivery is valid. Untracked bundle proliferation is not.
